plugin.name: True Crime New York City PCSX2F Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows the emulator display. Override with a width:height ratio or decimal; set the emulator display to the same ratio. Changes apply during play.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay camera's field of view, on foot and in vehicles; 1.0 is the original framing. Cutscenes keep their own framing. Changes apply during play.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the health, badge, weapon and ammunition, the help boxes and the radar at the screen edges. A ratio keeps them at the edges of a centered box of that shape. Changes apply during play.
CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars in cutscenes. Letterbox keeps the original bars above and below, Pillarbox keeps the original 4:3 picture with bars at the sides, Both combines them, Off fills the screen. Menus keep their own look. Changes apply during play.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: The bars slide in and out as in the original. Off shows and removes them at once. Changes apply during play.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Activision and Luxoflux logo video at startup. Restart the game to apply.
FPSLimit.description: Runs the game at 60 frames per second instead of 30. The one mission that needs the original speed keeps 30. Restart the game to apply.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Runs the emulator at full speed during startup and loading screens and returns to normal speed afterwards. Restart the game to apply.
